status: DRAFT v1, 8 Nov 2026, voiced (trim 1.07). Pitch 'could not be built' dropped (not supported); honest angle is money (C01). verify.md wording fixes 1-4 applied.
title: India Couldn't Afford This Coast Railway in 1969. It Opened in 1998
wording_notes: One dated refusal only (RS 11 Aug 1969): no 'kept saying' / 'for decades'.
'to raise the money' attributed to Sida (C10); Sida's 1990 'impossible to raise Rs 10 billion' not used.
No claim that engineers called it impossible.
Route drawn from approximate station points, labelled 'route simplified'.

beats.say: In nineteen sixty-nine, the government told Parliament it couldn't afford it, 'at present'.
beats.caption: 1969: Govt told Parliament: not possible 'at present' (money)

beats.say: A railway down India's western Konkan coast, for about sixty crore rupees.
beats.caption: Konkan line · ≈ Rs 60 crore (1969 estimate)

beats.say: Its first sixty-two kilometres opened only in nineteen eighty-six.
beats.caption: First 62 km (Apta–Roha): opened March 1986

beats.say: In nineteen ninety, a new company was set up. A Swedish aid review says: to raise the money.
beats.caption: 1990: Konkan Railway Corporation · Sida: set up to raise the money

beats.say: The deadline: four and a half years. Even the builder called that unrealistic.
beats.caption: Target: 4.5 years · KRCL: 'by no means realistic'

beats.say: The worst part was tunnelling through soft soil in Goa.
beats.caption: Hardest: soft-soil tunnels, mainly in Goa (Sida)

beats.say: The whole line opened on Republic Day, nineteen ninety-eight.
beats.caption: Roha–Thokur, 738.941 km · open 26 Jan 1998

beats.say: 'Not at present' in sixty-nine. Open end to end by ninety-eight.
beats.caption: 1969: 'not at present' · 1998: open
